overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、国际贸易（2 篇）、金融科技（1 篇）。方法上以横截面分析、随机森林为主。来源分布：arXiv（6 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Tree-Based Classification of Functional Groups from IR Spectra: Feature Importance Corroborates Quantum-Chemical Fragment Frequencies
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy is a widely used analytical technique for identifying functional groups (FGs) in chemical compounds, but its interpretation remains labor-intensive and reliant on expert knowledge, especially for complex or multicomponent samples. This study presents a tree-based random forest (RF) machine-learning framework, successfully developed to predict the presence of specific FG from an infrared spectra database. Stratification was employed to address positive class imbalance, maintaining the F1-score drop under 12% across models. All models achieved strong overall performance, with accuracy, F1-score, ROC-AUC, and out-of-bag (OOB) scores exceeding 0.8. Of the 46 FGs modeled, 43 demonstrated acceptable performance, while only three underperformed, as categorized by their Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and precision-recall area under the curve (PR-AUC) scores. Threshold tuning further improved model performance, yielding up to a 9% increase in MCC score. Finally, feature importance extracted from the trained models exhibited strong interpretability, correlating with theoretically predicted IR spectra and bridging experimental data with theoretical chemical significance. These results establish a robust, interpretable framework with potential for integration into intelligent monitoring and process optimization systems.
papers.summary_zh:
【国际贸易】摘要  
傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱技术是一种广泛用于识别化学化合物中官能团（FGs）的分析方法，但其解释过程仍较为繁琐，且依赖于专家知识，尤其是对于复杂或多组分样品而言。本研究提出了一种基于树的随机森林（RF）机器学习框架，该框架能够从红外光谱数据库中准确预测特定官能团的存在。为解决正类样本不平衡问题，采用了分层采样策略，使得所有模型的F1分数下降幅度控制在12%以内。所有模型的整体性能均表现出色，其准确率、F1分数、ROC-AUC值以及留一法（OOB）评估结果均超过0.8。在所建模的46个官能团中，有43个官能团的预测效果令人满意，仅有3个官能团的预测性能不佳（根据马修斯相关系数（MCC）和精确度-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC）进行评估）。通过调整阈值，模型性能进一步提升，MCC分数最高提升了9%。从训练模型中提取的特征重要性具有很强的可解释性，这些特征与理论预测的红外光谱结果高度吻合，有助于将实验数据与理论化学意义联系起来。这些研究结果表明，所提出的框架具有较高的稳健性和可解释性，有望应用于智能监测和过程优化系统。。研究方法：随机森林、实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Integrating AI General Education with Digital Literacy Cultivation and Cognitive Construction in Industry-Specific Universities
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has evolved into a general-purpose technology that permeates nearly every corner of knowledge production and social governance. This transformation is pushing college students' digital literacy far beyond the traditional "digitization" benchmark toward what this paper terms "intelligent-digital" literacy. For industry-specific universities—institutions committed to serving specific industries and cultivating application-oriented talents—the significance of AI general education is perhaps even greater than for other types of universities, because their graduates directly enter the industrial chain. Taking the practice of Moutai Institute as a concrete case, this paper elaborates on the internal logic, practical challenges, and feasible pathways for integrating AI general education into students' digital literacy cultivation and cognitive construction. The core argument of this paper is that such education should be anchored in industrial scenarios rather than abstract theory, and that cultivating compound talents equipped with digital literacy, industrial awareness, and social responsibility requires simultaneously grasping three main threads: technological empowerment, value guidance, and cognitive construction. On this basis, this paper proposes a trinity integration framework and offers actionable strategies from four dimensions: curriculum system, teaching model, faculty development, and evaluation mechanism. This paper aims to provide theoretical reference and practical insights for general education reform in industry-specific universities.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】人工智能已发展成为一种通用技术，几乎渗透到知识生产和社会治理的每一个领域。这一变革正在将大学生的数字素养提升至传统“数字化”标准之上，本文将其称为“智能数字化”素养。对于那些专注于服务特定行业并培养应用型人才的行业型大学而言，人工智能通识教育的重要性可能更为突出，因为这些大学的毕业生将直接进入产业链。以茅台学院的实际案例为例，本文详细阐述了将人工智能通识教育融入学生数字素养培养和认知构建过程中的内在逻辑、实际挑战及可行路径。本文的核心观点是，此类教育应基于行业场景而非抽象理论展开；要培养具备数字素养、行业意识和社会责任的复合型人才，需要同时把握三个关键方面：技术赋能、价值引导和认知构建。在此基础上，本文提出了一个三位一体整合框架，并从课程体系、教学模式、师资发展及评估机制四个维度提出了可操作的策略。本文旨在为行业型大学的通识教育改革提供理论参考与实践启示。。

papers.title: Hedging out the HEDGE Bias: Identifying Dynamic Partial-Equilibrium Effects with Panel LP-IV
papers.abstract: Cross-sectional designs are widely used to estimate dynamic partial-equilibrium effects of an aggregate treatment. We show analytically that these estimates are biased when exposures to the treatment and to aggregate confounders are correlated or the confounders feed back into the treatment. This paper develops the heterogeneous-exposure local-projection instrumental variables (HELP-IV) framework, which compares units while holding the confounder path fixed by instrumenting the treatment and this path with exposure-weighted shock proxies. We prove that HELP-IV identifies the partial-equilibrium effect. We further extend the framework, with the corresponding inference, to multiple exposure margins and confounders, forward-looking outcomes, and cumulative multipliers. Finally, we apply HELP-IV to state fiscal multipliers and regional stock-wealth effects, where it yields partial-equilibrium effects that are smaller than conventional estimates and deliver different implications when ported to macroeconomic models.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】横截面设计被广泛用于估计某种总体性政策干预的动态局部均衡效应。我们从理论上证明了：当政策干预与总体性混杂因素之间存在相关性，或者这些混杂因素反过来影响政策干预效果时，此类估计结果会出现偏差。本文提出了异质性暴露局部投影工具变量（HELP-IV）框架，该框架通过为政策干预和暴露加权冲击代理变量设置工具变量，从而在固定混杂因素影响路径的前提下对不同个体进行比较。我们证明了HELP-IV方法能够有效识别局部均衡效应。此外，我们还将该框架扩展到多重暴露因素、前瞻性结果以及累积乘数的分析中，并对相应的推断方法进行了改进。最后，我们将HELP-IV方法应用于州级财政政策效应和区域财富变动的研究，发现其得出的局部均衡效应低于传统估计值，并且在应用于宏观经济模型时会产生不同的政策含义。。研究方法：工具变量、横截面分析、均衡模型。

papers.title: Semiparametric Inference in Panel Data with Interactive and High-dimensional Confounding
papers.abstract: This paper develops inference for a low-dimensional treatment coefficient in partially linear panel models with high-dimensional observed covariates and latent interactive confounding. Flexible adjustment for observed covariates can leave correlated factor components in treatment and outcome residuals, invalidating standard double/debiased machine learning (DML). We propose Factor-Augmented DML (FA-DML), which estimates treatment-side and reduced-form factor spaces from first-stage residuals. The estimator combines a feasible double projection with three-fold, unit-level cross-fitting. The double projection controls interactions between the two estimated factor spaces. The separate folds eliminate same-training-unit pairings in the leading disturbance components of the factor-estimation errors. Under fixed factor ranks, pervasive factor signals, strict exogeneity, and joint asymptotics in the number of units N and periods T , FA-DML is first-order equivalent to an infeasible oracle, is asymptotically normal, and admits consistent variance estimation. In the baseline simulation design with strong interactive confounding, FA-DML confidence intervals have coverage close to the nominal level. Standard DML and a two-fold variant that estimates both factor spaces on the same units substantially undercover. In an application to U.S. states, FA-DML finds that a 10% increase in the real minimum wage is associated with a roughly 1.1% lower 50/10 wage ratio. The estimate is stable across control sets and first-stage learners.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文针对部分线性面板模型中低维处理效应系数进行了推断分析，这些模型具有高维观测协变量和潜在的交互性混杂因素。由于对观测协变量的灵活调整，处理组和结果组残差中可能存在相关的因子成分，这使得传统的双重/无偏机器学习（DML）方法失效。我们提出了因子增强型DML（FA-DML）方法，该方法通过第一阶段残差来估计处理组相关的因子空间及简化形式的因子结构。该估计器结合了可行的双重投影技术与三重、单元级别的交叉验证方法，双重投影用于控制两个因子空间之间的交互作用；交叉验证则避免了同一训练单元在因子估计误差中的配对效应。在因子排名固定、因子信号普遍存在、外生性严格以及样本数量N和时期T共同增长的情况下，FA-DML方法在统计性质上等价于一个“不可实现的理想模型”，其估计结果具有渐近正态性，并能实现一致的方差估计。在存在强交互性混杂的基准模拟设计中，FA-DML方法的置信区间覆盖率接近名义水平；而传统的DML方法及其在同一单元上同时估计两个因子空间的变体方法则表现较差。在美国各州的应用研究中，FA-DML发现实际最低工资每增加10%，50%与10%工资比率会下降约1.1%。该估计结果在不同对照组...。研究方法：数值模拟、机器学习。

papers.title: Beyond Export Dominance: Structural Transformation, Smallholder Welfare and Sustainability Trade-Offs in Indonesia’s Plantation Economy
papers.venue: Journal of Global Economics and Finance Studies
papers.abstract: Indonesia’s plantation subsector has emerged as the principal contributor to agricultural export earnings, yet aggregate trade success does not establish equitable rural welfare or ecological sustainability. Drawing on a qualitative literature review of peer reviewed research published between 2020 and 2026 and the official performance indicators reported through October 2026, this article synthesizes macroeconomic, commodity-chain, household, industrial, and environmental evidence. The review identifies five linked tensions: export concentration versus resilience; output and trade performance versus distributional welfare; down streaming versus opportunity cost; certification compliance versus smallholder inclusion; and production intensification versus environmental additionality. Reported January–August 2026 plantation exports reached IDR 503.3 trillion, with oil palm accounting for approximately 70.6% of that total. These figures demonstrate structural importance but cannot independently identify causal household benefits. Evidence suggests that plantation development can reduce poverty and improve human capital under favorable conditions, while insecure land rights, replanting barriers, uneven access to certification, and environmental externalities constrain those gains. The article advances a multilevel framework linking external markets, national institutions, value-chain governance, and household–landscape outcomes. It recommends multidimensional performance reporting, inclusive producer finance, selective downstreaming, commodity diversification, and independently verified conservation outcomes. The resulting framework supports a more balanced interpretation of plantation-sector success and an actionable agenda for resilient rural transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】印度尼西亚的种植园产业已成为农业出口收入的主要来源，然而总体贸易成就并未带来公平的农村福利或生态可持续性。本文基于2020年至2026年间发表的同行评审研究以及截至2026年10月的官方绩效指标，综合了宏观经济、商品链、家庭、产业和环境方面的证据。研究指出了五个相互关联的矛盾现象：出口集中度与产业韧性之间的矛盾；产出和贸易表现与分配福利之间的矛盾；产业链下游延伸与机会成本之间的矛盾；认证合规性与小农户参与度之间的矛盾；以及生产集约化与环境效益之间的矛盾。2026年1月至8月期间，印度尼西亚的种植园出口总额达到503.3万亿印尼盾，其中油棕产业占比约为70.6%。这些数据凸显了该产业的重要地位，但无法单独说明其对家庭福祉的因果作用。研究表明，在有利条件下，种植园发展有助于减少贫困并提升人力资本水平；然而，不稳定的土地权利、重新种植的障碍、认证渠道的不平等以及环境外部性等因素会限制这些积极效应的发挥。本文提出了一种多层次分析框架，将外部市场、国家制度、价值链治理以及家庭与生态环境的相互关系纳入考量。建议采用多维度绩效评估机制、提供包容性的生产融资支持、实施有针对性的产业链延伸策略、推...。

papers.title: Beyond the Five-Percent Growth Paradox: Economic Fragility, Policy Credibility and Investor Confidence in Indonesia
papers.venue: Journal of Global Economics and Finance Studies
papers.abstract: Indonesia's persistent growth near five percent presents a developmental paradox: macroeconomic stability can coexist with insecure employment, a vulnerable middle class, weak productive credit allocation, and fragile investor confidence. The 2026 sequence of capital-market scrutiny, a severe October equity correction, negative sovereign-rating outlooks, and currency depreciation intensifies the need to separate immediate triggers from structural causes. This qualitative literature review synthesizes 53 peer reviewed articles published between 2020 and 2026, supported by dated institutional releases. A purposive, theory-informed and critically interpretive synthesis—not a systematic review—identifies six linked themes: job-quality divergence, household vulnerability, regulatory uncertainty, credit-allocation inefficiency, market-integrity concerns, and fiscal tradeoffs. The paper proposes an integrated mechanism through which unpredictable policy commitments may discourage irreversible investment while external portfolio shocks magnify financing pressures. Its findings do not demonstrate that domestic policy alone caused the 2026 market disruptions or that an undrawn loan commitment represents idle investable cash. The review also treats school feeding as a potentially valuable human-capital investment whose results and opportunity costs require independent evaluation. It recommends transparent beneficial-ownership disclosure, credible and coordinated regulation, outcome-based fiscal governance, employment-centered productivity reform, and improved small-business credit pathways. A sequenced institutional framework and research agenda specify measurable tests for these propositions. The central implication is that Indonesia's economic resilience depends on both credible financial institutions and the capacity to transform growth into widely shared, secure livelihoods.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】印度尼西亚持续保持近5%的增长率，这一现象揭示了一个发展悖论：宏观经济稳定与就业不稳定性、中产阶级脆弱性、生产性信贷分配不足以及投资者信心低迷并存。2026年资本市场的持续动荡（包括10月份的严重股市调整）、负面的主权评级前景以及货币贬值，进一步凸显了区分短期诱因与结构性问题的必要性。本研究通过定性文献综述整合了2020年至2026年间发表的53篇经过同行评审的文章，并参考了相关机构发布的最新数据。作为一种基于理论且具有批判性解读的综合性分析（而非系统性综述），研究发现了六个相互关联的主题：就业质量差异、家庭脆弱性、监管不确定性、信贷分配效率低下、市场诚信问题以及财政政策之间的权衡。文章提出了一种综合机制，认为不可预测的政策承诺可能抑制投资活动，而外部市场冲击则会加剧融资压力。研究结果并未表明2026年的市场动荡完全由国内政策引发，也未表明未使用的贷款承诺意味着资金闲置。此外，研究还将学校供餐视为一项具有潜在价值的人力资本投资，其效果和机会成本需要单独评估。研究建议加强透明度的有益所有权信息披露机制、制定可信且协调一致的监管政策、推行以就业为导向的生产力改革，并改善小型企业的信贷...。

papers.title: The Hidden Sharpe Ratio
papers.abstract: We estimate the maximal Sharpe ratio in large cross-sections of assets directly, without constructing the efficient portfolio. Covariance estimation in this setting requires regularization, which suppresses the contribution of small-eigenvalue directions. Our estimator progressively recovers this contribution, yielding tight upper and lower bounds with asymptotic confidence intervals. We further show that ridge-regularized Markowitz portfolios, the construction underlying many existing high-Sharpe benchmarks, deliver out-of-sample Sharpe ratios that fall short of the true maximum by an explicit, non-vanishing multiplicative factor. Applied to U.S. equities, the method delivers an estimated maximal annualized Sharpe ratio of approximately 7.4, or 5.0 once micro-cap stocks are excluded, substantially exceeding existing portfolio-based benchmarks of 1.0–4.0. Adding corporate bonds raises the maximum, though not by a statistically significant margin. Nonlinear portfolio weights dominate linear ones, and characteristics introduced after 2004 contribute little additional Sharpe ratio.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们直接估计了大量资产组合中的最大夏普比率，而无需构建有效投资组合。在这种设定下，协方差估计需要采用正则化方法，以抑制小特征值方向对结果的影响。我们的估计器能够逐步恢复这部分影响，从而得到具有渐近置信区间的严格上下界。进一步研究表明，基于岭回归正则化的马科维茨投资组合（许多现有高夏普比率基准的构建方法）所计算出的样本外夏普比率，实际上比真实最大值低一个非零的乘数。将该方法应用于美国股票市场，估计得到的年化最大夏普比率约为7.4；若排除微型股，则为5.0，远高于现有的基于投资组合的基准值（1.0–4.0）。加入企业债券虽然能提高最大夏普比率，但提升幅度并不具有统计学意义。非线性投资组合权重相较于线性权重更具优势；此外，2004年之后引入的某些投资特征对夏普比率的提升作用有限。。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence dalam Manajemen Krisis: Pengembangan Dashboard Adaptif untuk Mendukung Pengambilan Keputusan
papers.abstract: Pemanfaatan Artificial Intelligence (AI) dalam manajemen krisis memiliki potensi untuk mendukung pengolahan informasi dan pengambilan keputusan pada situasi yang dinamis dan penuh ketidakpastian. Penelitian ini bertujuan menghasilkan prototipe dashboard manajemen krisis adaptif berbasis AI yang mengintegrasikan analisis informasi krisis, simulasi skenario, dan rekomendasi pendukung keputusan dengan mekanisme human-in-the-loop. Penelitian dilakukan melalui empat tahap, yaitu kajian literatur dan analisis kebutuhan, perancangan arsitektur sistem, pengembangan prototipe dashboard, serta demonstrasi dan evaluasi fungsional berbasis skenario. Hasil penelitian menghasilkan prototipe AI Crisis Management Dashboard yang merepresentasikan berbagai sumber informasi krisis, pemrosesan data berlapis, serta rancangan fungsi analitik untuk analisis kerusakan, prediksi kondisi, analisis komunikasi, dan rekomendasi alokasi sumber daya. Sistem juga menyediakan mekanisme konfirmasi dan penolakan rekomendasi AI sehingga keputusan akhir tetap melibatkan operator. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa prototipe yang dikembangkan mampu mengintegrasikan fungsi analitik AI, tata kelola, dan keterlibatan manusia dalam satu lingkungan pendukung keputusan. Validasi menggunakan data aktual dan pengujian pengguna diperlukan untuk mengevaluasi efektivitas sistem pada kondisi operasional.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）在危机管理中的应用具有潜力，能够在动态且充满不确定性的环境中支持信息处理和决策制定。本研究旨在开发一种基于AI的适应性危机管理仪表板原型，该原型整合了危机信息分析、场景模拟以及决策支持功能，并采用了“人机交互”（human-in-the-loop）机制。研究过程分为四个阶段：文献调研与需求分析、系统架构设计、仪表板原型开发，以及基于场景的功能演示与评估。最终开发出的AI危机管理仪表板原型能够整合多种危机信息来源，实现多层次的数据处理，并包含用于损害分析、状况预测、沟通分析及资源分配建议的功能模块。该系统还配备了AI建议的确认与拒绝机制，以确保最终决策仍由操作人员主导。研究结果表明，所开发的原型成功地将AI分析功能、系统管理机制与人类参与度整合到了一个统一的决策支持框架中。为评估系统在实际操作环境中的有效性，还需通过真实数据验证及用户测试来进行进一步验证。。

papers.title: Point-in-Time Encoders for Earnings Calls
papers.abstract: Text encoders turn earnings calls into vectors for search, for language models that answer from retrieved passages, and for forecasting models. A live retriever can use an encoder trained once on all available text, as finance retrievers are, but a backtest needs an encoder that read no text written after the date of each vector. To address this look-ahead bias, from 412,248 calls we train vintages under four pretraining recipes, with yearly cutoffs from 2010 to 2024, and each vintage reads only text dated on or before its cutoff. We then fine-tune each vintage on the question-answer pairs of the calls themselves. The vintages we train on calls alone, with 33.8M parameters, retrieve answers on held-out calls better than the general retrievers we tested in every test quarter. Their vectors also raise by about half the rank correlation between next-day returns and forecasts built from past returns and firm size. When each vintage continues the previous one, a later vintage retrieves better on earlier quarters than the vintage available at the time, and a point-in-time language model that answers from the passages the later vintage retrieves inherits the gain. The 2024 vintage of our families also forecasts earnings surprises better, although the interval of this gain includes zero on calls that no vintage read. It forecasts returns no better, so point-in-time vintages matter most for retrieval and little for forecasts of returns.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】文本编码器将财报电话会议内容转换为向量，用于语言模型的搜索、以及预测模型的输入数据。实时检索系统可以使用一次训练完成的编码器（例如金融领域的检索系统所使用的编码器），但回测则需要使用一种不会读取任何在向量生成日期之后发布的文本的编码器。为了解决这种“前瞻性偏差”问题，我们从412,248份财报电话会议记录中，按照四种不同的预训练方法分别训练了多个版本的编码器，这些版本的训练时间跨度从2010年到2024年，每个版本仅处理在其训练截止日期之前发布的文本。随后，我们利用这些编码器本身包含的问题-答案数据对对它们进行微调。仅使用这些编码器训练得到的模型（拥有3380万个参数）在每个测试季度中，其检索结果均优于我们测试过的其他通用检索系统。这些编码器生成的向量显著提升了次日股价回报与基于历史回报及公司规模构建的预测结果之间的相关性（相关性提高了约50%）。当一个版本的编码器在另一个版本的基础上进行进一步训练时，后续版本在处理早期季度的数据时表现更优；同时，基于后续版本生成的文本进行回答的即时语言模型也能继承这种改进效果。我们训练的2024年版本的编码器在预测财报惊喜（即实际收益与预期收益...。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Operator Maps in Optimal Liquidation
papers.abstract: We analyze the solution map of a optimal execution problem in which price dynamics are subject to a general transient impact kernel. Given the structure of the optimal trading strategy derived by Abi Jaber and Neuman in \cite{https://doi.org/10.1111/mafi.12465}, we show that the strategy is locally Lipschitz continuous with respect to the underlying model parameters governing temporary and transient price impact as well as the fundamental price process. Continuity of this map justifies the application of neural-net based approximations which take model parameters as inputs. We propose a method generating samples of the transient price impact kernel for the purposes of creating training data, and a method of projecting the kernel to a finite dimensional representation appropriate for input to a neural net, and a dimensional reduction based on the relationship between inventory and trade signal. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the trained neural net and use it to quantify the potential financial costs associated with misspecifying the transient impact kernel.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们分析了一个最优执行问题的解映射，其中价格动态受到一般性瞬态影响核的制约。基于Abi Jaber和Neuman在\cite{https://doi.org/10.1111/mafi.12465}中推导出的最优交易策略结构，我们证明了该策略对于控制临时性和瞬态价格影响的模型参数以及基础价格过程是局部利普希茨连续的。这种映射的连续性为使用以模型参数为输入的神经网络近似方法提供了理论依据。我们提出了一种生成瞬态价格影响核样本的方法，用于创建训练数据；同时提出了一种将该核投影到适合神经网络输入的有限维表示的方法，以及一种基于库存与交易信号之间关系的降维方法。我们验证了训练有素的神经网络的有效性，并利用它来量化因错误指定瞬态影响核而可能产生的潜在财务成本。。

papers.title: Estimating multidimensional poverty under incomplete data in North Macedonia
papers.abstract: Multidimensional Poverty Indices (MPIs) are available for more than 100 countries, but rarely below the national or regional level. Local estimates require knowing how deprivations overlap within households, yet the sources that cover every locality, such as censuses and geospatial data, cannot be linked at the household level. We show how to measure local multidimensional poverty under such incomplete data, using North Macedonia as a case study. Combining settlement-level access to services with municipal census data, we pair an independence-based point estimate with sharp bounds over all joint distributions consistent with the data. We find that, nationally, 5.01 percent of households are multidimensionally poor, with bounds of 2.01 to 17.44 percent. Also, poverty is concentrated in small rural municipalities, which are poorer than nearly all municipalities of the capital city under any dependence structure. Validating our index against official statistics, the Global MPI, and a fieldwork deprivation index indicates that the socio-economic part of the index is consistent with external measures of deprivation, while the geographic part captures a distinct dimension of remoteness. Our approach thus presents a promising way to measure multidimensional poverty at the local level in countries where linked household data are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】多维贫困指数（MPIs）已为100多个国家提供，但通常仅在国家或地区层面进行应用。要获得更详细的本地贫困数据，需要了解家庭内部各种贫困状况的相互关联程度，然而涵盖所有地区的统计资料（如人口普查数据和地理空间数据）无法在家庭层面进行关联。本文以北马其顿为例，探讨了如何在数据不完整的情况下测量本地多维贫困。通过结合居民点层面的服务获取情况与市级人口普查数据，我们采用基于独立性的点估计方法，并为所有与数据相符的联合分布设定明确的界限。研究发现，全国范围内有5.01%的家庭处于多维贫困状态，这一比例的上下限分别为2.01%至17.44%。此外，贫困现象主要集中在小型农村市镇，这些市镇的贫困程度几乎超过了所有首都所在市镇。将我们的指数与官方统计数据（全球多维贫困指数）及实地调查得出的贫困指标进行比对后发现，该指数的社会经济部分与外部贫困衡量标准一致，而地理部分则有效反映了地区的偏远程度。因此，这种方法为那些缺乏家庭数据关联性的国家提供了一种可行的方式，用于在本地层面测量多维贫困状况。。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning an Order-Flow Foundation Model for Sub-Second Forecasting
papers.abstract: Generative models have become the standard approach in language and vision. These models are typically pretrained first and then fine-tuned. Recent work demonstrates how to pretrain an autoregressive generative model on Level-3 order-flow data. However, to our knowledge, no one has fine-tuned such a model yet for downstream tasks.   Here we first pretrain a 300M-parameter generative model on Level-3 order-flow data collected from two crypto exchanges, Bitstamp and Bitfinex. Then we fine-tune the pretrained model to predict the microprice return and its realized volatility. We show that our fine-tuned model outperforms classical baselines, such as gradient boosting on handcrafted features, in predicting microprice returns over sub-second horizons. Furthermore, the predictive ability of the model transfers zero-shot to assets it was never fine-tuned on. Due to the short-term nature of these forecasts, the predicted microprice moves are smaller than the bid-ask spread plus fees, so the natural applications are in execution and market making.   These results indicate that a pretrained generative model can be turned into a competitive short-horizon price forecaster via fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】生成模型已成为语言和视觉领域的研究标准方法。这类模型通常先进行预训练，然后再进行微调。近期的一些研究展示了如何使用自回归生成模型对三级订单流数据（Level-3 order-flow data）进行预训练。然而，据我们所知，目前尚未有人将此类模型用于下游任务的微调。在本研究中，我们首先使用从Bitstamp和Bitfinex两家加密货币交易所收集的三级订单流数据，对一个包含3亿参数的生成模型进行预训练。随后，我们对该预训练模型进行微调，以预测微价格回报（microprice return）及其实际波动率（realized volatility）。实验结果表明，经过微调的模型在预测亚秒级时间范围内的微价格回报方面，优于传统的基线方法（例如基于手工特征构建的梯度提升模型）。此外，该模型的预测能力可以“零样本迁移”（zero-shot transfer）到从未进行过微调的其他资产上。由于这些预测的周期较短，预测出的微价格变动幅度通常小于买卖价差加上手续费，因此该模型在交易执行（execution）和市场做市（market making）领域具有实际应用价值。这些研究结果表明，通过微调，...。研究方法：梯度提升。
